title: James R NDE 400
content: After following my older cousin into the pool the air was knocked out of me, I couldn't swim and I took in water. Vividly remember watching myself bobbing in the middle of the (3D) pool as Craig fished me out. I was separate from my body standing at my head as they performed 1960's style resuscitation. Two dark bodies were having an argument about my presence. Yes, no, maybe. There was something important I had to do.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain learned I didn't float Clinical death I was swimming and followed an older cousin off the high diving board.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning This is uncertain, the time was so distorted twenty minutes felt like two.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Just the discussion of the two (aliens, inter-dimensional) beings and the sounds of the crisis, 'He has no pulse, he is dead...etc.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes They said nothing to me directly until I decided that maybe there was something to what they were saying about having something important to finish.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Sorry it is not time yet - Vancouver Island will crack off and slip into the pacific the same time as California goes.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Awareness of pregnant women one hundred percent accuracy on sex and stillborn. Empathic to a strong degree strong psi on presence of animals, people.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will See above.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will See above. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes They were so immature at the time - I am truly a round peg that fits into square holes for a short time. Father was a Presbyterian minister not my cup of tea. I have explored the spiritual realms.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some were lost some understood some had the same dreams mostly when I described their past lives and their lives past. I have described some futures and they were surprised when prophesy fulfilled.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Speed at the time of end of LSD, peyote, pot at various times and incarnations.
